thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — spotted several examples on /api/generate that still use `max_new_tokens` and expect `choices[0].text`.

kai: oy. which files?

emma: docs/api/generate.md, examples/generate.json, and openapi/components/examples/generate-response.json. also a troubleshooting curl uses `X-Request-Id` header; we now canonicalize it to `x-rw-request-id`.

robin: i'll open a single PR to fix the param name, response examples, and curl header. will sweep SDK snippets for old imports.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 — tagged: emma, kai, robin :robot:

lee: streaming JS also changed: old events used `type: 'delta'` with `delta.text`. new streams use `type: 'message'` and `message.parts` (array). i'll update the streaming example and add a helper to join partial parts.

robin: pushed openapi patch: replaced `choices` -> `outputs`, set operationId: `generateText`, and added `x-example-id` to keep anchors stable.

kai: updated python quickstart `from redwood import Client` -> `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient` and adjusted example code.

emma: added a short migration note at top of the page: "If you previously used `max_new_tokens`, switch to `max_tokens` and read responses from `outputs[].content`."

robin: CI docs-validate flagged examples/generate.json initially. i updated examples to match schema and added a test in CI to run `npm run docs-validate -- examples/generate.json`.

lee: preview looks good: https://pr-1102.docs.redwood.ai — anchors preserved after adding explicit HTML ids where needed.

docs-bot: docs-preview deploy queued for pr-1102 — will post URL when ready :rocket:

preview-bot: preview ready: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1102 — please sanity-check codeblocks and headings.

emma: validated rendering; codeblocks render, streaming helper shows `const text = message.parts.join('')`.

kai: product-docs asked for a brief Go snippet to show reading `Outputs[0].Content`. added a 2-line example.

robin: merging after api-team signoff. will add a note in release notes about: param rename, response shape change, header normalization, and Python SDK import update.

release-bot: noted for release notes: "API: max_new_tokens -> max_tokens; responses: choices -> outputs[].content; header: X-Request-Id -> x-rw-request-id; Python SDK: redwood_sdk.RedwoodClient." :rocket:

emma: thanks all — quick turnaround appreciated :thumbsup:

infra-bot: docs validation CI job completed successfully.
